text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I need to make up my mind soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The message that arrived on my smartphone 
was from <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they're planning to "hold 
voluntary training among the members." 
After checking the details, I give them my 
approval.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the first "Representative Exchange 
Match," a bond among comrades began to 
blossom—not only between the Trainers, but 
between the Umamusume as well.
choice_data_list:
—We're going to aim for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe together.

—Together, we're aiming for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wall we must overcome is high. That is 
precisely why everyone must work together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: [Sender: Satake Mei]

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to interrupt when you're busy. 
There is something I need to tell you all 
once again."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"After the second Representative Exchange 
Race, I will select four of you to 
represent Japan."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...These four are the ones running in the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Only four people? Out of all of 
us...?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You were prepared for this, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the 
pinnacle of racing. It's not just 
Japan—contenders from all over the world 
are aiming for the top."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing into the starting lineup ain't 
easy either. We should focus on quality 
over quantity.
choice_data_list:
...That's why we're entering an Uma Musume 
who can win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Even without narrowing it down to 
just the elite, until race registration, 
everyone here could—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way an Umamusume who wasn't 
chosen here could ever take the title of 
number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...We ain't going there just to make 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if we cooperate as a team, it's so 
that we can become stronger ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them, 
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"The announcement is scheduled immediately 
following the conclusion of Race 2 of the 
Representative Exchange Matches."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even if someone isn't chosen as a 
representative, I will arrange it so that 
anyone who wishes can accompany us to 
France.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, when selecting Japan's 
"representatives," we plan to take into 
account their running up through the 
exchange meet itself.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I want you to pour all your strength 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dozens of Umamusume are participating 
in 'Project L'Arc.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are <chrname>'s companions. Sharing the same 
ambition, dividing joys and sorrows, and 
continuing to hone each other going 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, only four representatives will be 
chosen for Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how deep the bond becomes. No 
matter how well one understands the 
other's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them, 
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...What's with the gloomy look on your 
face?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Pass a message along to your trainee for 
me. Tell them today's self-training was 
called off, so let's do it tomorrow 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I got a message from <chrname> 
earlier. She said she's doing joint 
self-training with Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be competing with her for the 
title of Japan's 'Representative.' For one 
of only four spots."
choice_data_list:
...Are you sure you won't regret helping 
out?

...Are you sure you won't regret helping 
out?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sirius said it too, right? We cooperate 
like a team so that we can all become 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Letting a chance like that slip through 
your fingers would be beyond wasteful.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's competitive career is 
short. They dedicate the most precious 
time of their lives to take on this 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you've got the foundation to put in the 
work, you might as well go all in on it. 
Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Because we worked together, there were 
things we finally came to understand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Things like, 'This guy looks like she 
could actually win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who gets picked for the team, 
there won't be any bad blood."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You know it too, don't you? When it comes 
to who makes the representative team, 
whether it's you guys or me... it wouldn't 
be surprising if it turned out to be 
someone entirely different.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That's just the kind of team this is. 
Give it your all and fight for that 
representative spot."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No matter who my opponent is, I never hold 
back.
